# C4 Tech Services

> > C4 Tech Services is a Minneapolis-based IT staffing and consulting firm specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365, DevOps, FinOps, and AI-driven digital transformation.

C4 Tech Services operates offices in Eagan, Minnesota and Dallas, Texas, providing comprehensive IT staffing, consulting, and workforce solutions to enterprises. The company combines talent acquisition with technical advisory services across cloud transformation, enterprise software, and financial operations optimization.

## Core Services

- [IT Staffing Agency](https://c4techservices.com/it-staffing-agency): IT staffing agency offering contract and permanent placements in Twin Cities
- [IT Consultant Company](https://c4techservices.com/it-consultant-company): IT consulting services including Microsoft Dynamics 365 and cloud solutions
- [Consulting Services](http://c4techservices.com/consulting): IT consulting with Microsoft Dynamics 365, DevOps, and FinOps expertise

## Technology Solutions

- [Microsoft Dynamics 365](https://c4techservices.com/microsoft-d365): Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management solutions
- [DevOps Solutions](https://c4techservices.com/devops): DevOps consulting and staffing for continuous engineering and automation
- [FinOps Services](https://c4techservices.com/FinOps): FinOps cloud cost optimization and financial strategy consulting services
- [Cloud Web Solutions](https://c4techservices.com/cloud-web): Cloud transformation and digital migration services with DevOps support
- [Artificial Intelligence Advisory](https://c4techservices.com/artificial-intelligence): AI advisory and adoption strategy for enterprise digital transformation

## Talent & Assessment

- [Skills Assure Campaign](https://c4techservices.com/skills-assure-campaign): Skills Assure pre-hire vetting and candidate assessment platform
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://c4techservices.com/ai-readiness-assessment): AI readiness assessment tool evaluating organizational maturity and strategy
- [Contract Worker Onboarding](http://c4techservices.com/staffing): Guide to contract worker onboarding and staffing firm partnerships
